mutations.contract: close=NULL action event is independent of price availability
mutations.pre_fix: 6731型factorを落とすとmarket cap/returnが100倍basisへ戻る
mutations.adjacent: event rowを価格session数・ADVへ混ぜない

mutations.contract: positive treasury followed by later issued-only row is indeterminate
mutations.pre_fix: 旧TrShを再控除して時価総額を過小化する
mutations.adjacent: explicit TrSh=0または新しいTrSh観測で再開する

mutations.contract: AvgSh is an EPS denominator, not gross issued shares
mutations.pre_fix: AvgSh fallbackと正のTrShの再控除でmarketable sharesを過小化する
mutations.post_fix: writer fallbackを除き、既存cacheは隣接恒等式が揃う行だけfail-closeする
mutations.adjacent: ShOutFY=AvgShだけの正常1Q行は停止しない

mutations.contract: direct and SQLite ClientV2 period aliases are identical
mutations.post_fix: 同じClientV2 payloadから同じperiod fieldsを作る
mutations.adjacent: missing/NaT period markerはNoneとして保持する

mutations.contract: same-period partial actual correction keeps the preferred field
mutations.pre_fix: 新しい部分訂正に営業利益が無いと純利益へfallbackする
mutations.post_fix: 同じ会計期間で観測済みの営業利益を優先する
mutations.adjacent: 古い会計期間の営業利益をcurrentへcarryしない

mutations.contract: TA and EqAR must be observed in the same state
mutations.pre_fix: 異なる開示日の値を掛けてPBRを歪める
mutations.post_fix: latest complete rowと公表精度intervalで選ぶ
mutations.adjacent: fresh BPS fallbackとnegative equity guardを維持する

mutations.contract: future bar cannot affect as-of output
mutations.pre_fix: future price/turnover注入でmarket capと流動性が変わる
mutations.adjacent: as-of以前20sessionの境界を維持する
